`f214739b8832e7f297cb9970d0c0efbf783f1462` (2026-11-01).

The two client source files are unmodified. Their upstream Git blob hashes are:

- `Client/libMTSClient.h` — `dee12c3b05345cfeef698d110aeab0b89a638a66`
- `Client/libMTSClient.cpp` — `9bbfb1ee0525fe529a27d4d5d1da346f6cd73a30`
